# 🎯 yTrain - Train Against Custom Zombies with Ease  

## 📖 Description  
A lightweight Bukkit/Spigot plugin designed to enhance PvE training by allowing players to spawn customizable zombies. Features a user-friendly GUI for managing zombie armor and totem counts, with full admin control over configurations.  

---

## ⚙️ Features  
- ✅ **Customizable zombie spawning** with adjustable health, absorption, and enchantments  
- ✅ **GUI for toggling armor** and setting totem counts  
- ✅ **Totem auto-equip** for zombies (simulated in 1.12, native in 1.16+)  
- ✅ **Configurable zombie settings** (name, visibility, glowing, etc.)  
- ✅ **Cooldown system** for spawning zombies  
- ✅ **Blacklisted worlds support**  
- ✅ **Admin configuration reload command**  

---

## 🔨 Commands  
<details>
<summary>📜 Command List</summary>

- **`/train`** - Open the training GUI to spawn a zombie  
- **`/yTrain reload`** - Reload the plugin configuration (admin only)  

</details>

---

## 🔑 Permissions  
<details>
<summary>🔐 Permissions List</summary>

- **`ytrain.train`** - Use `/train` to open the GUI and spawn zombies  
- **`ytrain.reload`** - Use `/yTrain reload` to reload the configuration  

</details>

---

## 📦 Dependencies  
**None**
